topics.title_zh: Meta调高2026年资本支出至1450亿，拟发无投票权新股续命AI豪赌
topics.title_en: Meta Hikes 2026 Capex to $145B and Creates Non-Voting Shares to Fund AI Bet
topics.summary_zh: Meta将2026年资本支出指引上限推升至1450亿美元，并决定创设无投票权新股筹资，同时扎克伯格面临加州富人税拟出走与250亿天价诉讼罚单夹击，引发治理权稀释与重资产现金流断裂质疑。
topics.summary_en: Meta raised its 2026 capex guidance up to $145 billion and announced a new non-voting share class to fuel AI cluster builds, amid legal headwinds and regulatory tax friction in California.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 万亿规模算力集群是AGI竞赛门票，通过无投票权股份融资能在保证扎克伯格战略控制权的同时，筑起不可逾越的模型算力护城河。
perspective_pro.point_en: Trillion-scale compute is the ante for AGI; non-voting equity protects strategic governance while funding an insurmountable infrastructure moat.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 资本纪律与股东权益派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 二级市场分析师与维权股东
perspective_con.point_zh: 年砸1450亿美元已陷入沉没成本陷阱，无投票权结构严重侵害普通股东知情监督权，一旦模型变现不及预期将引发灾难性资产减值。
perspective_con.point_en: Spending $145B annually risks a sunk-cost trap, and dual-class shares strip investor oversight just as cash returns from generative AI face severe execution risks.

topics.category_tag_zh: 自主智能体与系统颠覆
topics.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Duet后台自主Agent，直切消费级带货与工作流
topics.title_en: Anthropic Debuts Claude Duet Proactive Agent to Rival Meta Muse
topics.summary_zh: Anthropic正式发布首款后台常驻主动型Agent应用Claude Duet，与Meta Muse展开个人助理与商业闭环争夺；其底层API大版本激进剔除temperature等传统调参字段，全面走向确定性执行架构。
topics.summary_en: Anthropic rolled out Claude Duet, a proactive background agent application taking direct aim at Meta Muse, while fundamentally restructuring its Developer APIs for autonomous execution.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 任务自动化与具身工作流派
perspective_pro.point_zh: 从对话被动响应转向后台主动代劳是AI范式转移，锁定确定性API并引入长驻代理，是打通从多模态意图到现实事务闭环的必经之路。
perspective_pro.point_en: Shifting from reactive chat to proactive background execution is the next paradigm, bridging conversational models directly into actionable consumer workflows.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 确定性工程与合规审慎派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 企业架构师与企业安全审查官
perspective_con.point_zh: 后台静默操作带来了不可控的提权越界与金融扣费风险，强制废除灵活超参更暴露了底层执行逻辑对刚性Prompt工程的脆弱依赖。
perspective_con.point_en: Background agency introduces profound authorization vulnerabilities, while stripping temperature controls exposes brittle prompt hardcoding in production.

topics.category_tag_zh: 视频生成与商业化重构
topics.title_zh: 快手可灵4.0突袭30秒连贯长镜头，影视级单片成本骤降引爆广告工业
topics.title_en: Kuaishou Kling 4.0 Unleashes 30-Second Dynamic Scenes, Shaking Video Ad Pipelines
topics.summary_zh: 海外创作者与商业机构集中爆料快手可灵4.0支持30秒长镜头连续生成，且单模型整合角色、商品与音效管线，彻底颠覆跨工具拼装的传统广告制作流，在海外创作者社区掀起降本风暴。
topics.summary_en: Global creators reported Kuaishou's Kling 4.0 achieves unified 30-second coherent scene generation, integrating character, product, and voice pipelines into a single model step.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 出海广告制作商与AIGC艺术家
perspective_pro.point_zh: 可灵4.0终结了多工具割裂剪接的历史，单镜头30秒时空一致性与多要素合一，真正将AI视频从概念Demo推向百亿级商业广告流水线。
perspective_pro.point_en: Kling 4.0 solves temporal consistency for 30-second clips, consolidating disparate avatar and audio tools into an industrial-grade production pipeline.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 影视工业与物理常识派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 传统影视剪辑师与3D管线工程师
perspective_con.point_zh: 扩散模型生成的30秒长片段依然缺乏确定性物理控制与精细分镜重修能力，一旦特定商品细节变形，整段返工成本远超分层渲染。
perspective_con.point_en: Diffusion-generated long shots lack sub-frame physics controllability and local layer editing, making asset deformation costly for precision brand campaigns.
